# European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights (FRA)

> > The European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights (FRA) provides independent, evidence-based advice on fundamental rights to EU institutions and Member States.

Based in Vienna, Austria, FRA conducts research, collects data, and engages with stakeholders on fundamental rights issues including non-discrimination, Roma inclusion, violence against women, rule of law, asylum and migration, hate crime, and data protection across the European Union.

## Key Topics

- Fundamental Rights
- Non-discrimination
- Roma inclusion and surveys
- Violence against women
- Rule of law
- Hate speech and hate crime
- Asylum and migration
- Data protection
- Media freedom and journalist safety
- LGBTI+ rights
- Child-friendly justice
- European Commission cooperation
- Civil society engagement
- Discriminatory profiling prevention
- Frontex cooperation

## Core Agency Information

- [Informacje o agencji praw podstawowych unii europejskiej](http://fra.europa.eu/pl): Polish homepage about FRA fundamental rights agency and EU protection

## Research Data and Tools

- [Survey on violence against women in EU (2012)](http://fra.europa.eu/en/publications-and-resources/data-and-maps/survey-data-explorer-violence-against-women-survey): Interactive data explorer for 2012 EU-28 violence against women survey

## Events and Stakeholder Engagement

- [FRA Director presents the Fundamental Rights Report to LIBE](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2022/fra-director-presents-fundamental-rights-report-libe): Director O'Flaherty presents annual Fundamental Rights Report to LIBE
- [Protecting the safety of journalists and media freedom in the EU](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2022/protecting-safety-journalists-and-media-freedom-eu): FRA event on journalist safety and media freedom with UN, EC, and OSCE
- [Young people's rights and the future of Europe](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2021/young-peoples-rights-and-future-europe): Youth rights conference with Portuguese EU Presidency and Director O'Flaherty
- [Fundamental Rights Platform thematic meeting on EU Roma framework](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2021/fundamental-rights-platform-thematic-meeting-eu-roma-framework): FRA Platform meeting on EU Roma strategic framework for equality
- [FRA to contribute to EU – African Union Human Rights Dialogue](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2023/fra-contribute-eu-african-union-human-rights-dialogue): FRA contributes to EU-African Union dialogue on anti-racism and diversity
- [European Commission Dialogue on Roma inclusion](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2021/european-commission-dialogue-roma-inclusion): EC dialogue on Roma inclusion with FRA survey data and civil society
- [Frontex Consultative Forum on Fundamental Rights](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2021/frontex-consultative-forum-fundamental-rights): FRA participates in Frontex Forum on asylum, migration, and borders
- [EU High Level Group to combat hate speech and hate crime](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2022/eu-high-level-group-combat-hate-speech-and-hate-crime): FRA at EC High Level Group meeting on hate speech and crime in Brussels
- [National rule of law dialogue in Germany](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2022/national-rule-law-dialogue-germany): FRA participates in Germany rule of law dialogue with EC and Reynders
- [FRA joins panel on LGBTI+ sensitive justice systems for children in Europe](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2023/fra-joins-panel-lgbti-sensitive-justice-systems-children-europe): FRA webinar on child-friendly justice for LGBTI+ children with CFJ-EN

## Procurement and Tenders

- [Roma Survey 2020](http://fra.europa.eu/en/call-for-tender/2019/roma-survey-2020): FRA procurement tender for Roma Survey 2020 research project
- [Update of the FRA Guide on Preventing Discriminatory Profiling](http://fra.europa.eu/en/call-for-tender/2016/update-fra-guide-preventing-discriminatory-profiling): Tender to update FRA guide on preventing discriminatory ethnic profiling
- [Negotiated procedure for a middle value contract: Fundamental rights implications of the Entry/Exit System (EES)](http://fra.europa.eu/en/call-for-tender/2023/negotiated-procedure-middle-value-contract-fundamental-rights-implications): Procurement tender for Entry/Exit System fundamental rights research
- [Negotiated procedure for the low value contract - Update and development of a Handbook on European data protection law](http://fra.europa.eu/en/call-for-tender/2016/negotiated-procedure-low-value-contract-update-and-development-handbook-0): Tender for updating FRA-CoE Handbook on European data protection law

## Optional

- [FRA joins ELSA international strategy meeting](http://fra.europa.eu/en/event/2023/fra-joins-elsa-international-strategy-meeting): FRA participates in ELSA law students strategy meeting in Prague

- [Aufruf zur Interessenbekundung für die Erkundung des Marktes für die Suche nach Räumlichkeiten für die Agentur der Europäischen Union für Grundrechte (FRA), Wien, Österreich (2023)](http://fra.europa.eu/de/call-for-tender/2023/aufruf-zur-interessenbekundung-fuer-die-erkundung-des-marktes-fuer-die-suche): 2023 market exploration tender for FRA Vienna office space with BREEAM
- [Preliminary market survey of potential candidates - new tender procedure for removal and disposal of furniture for new FRA premises](http://fra.europa.eu/en/call-for-tender/2025/preliminary-market-survey-potential-candidates-new-tender-procedure-removal): Market survey for furniture removal tender for FRA Vienna relocation
